extension.description: A secure, local-only Markdown vault and Obsidian-style Live Preview editor for VS Code. No accounts, telemetry, or cloud sync.
viewContainer.title: Local Markdown Vault
config.title: Local Markdown Vault
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Plain Markdown editing remains available. Diagrams, custom CSS, remote media, attachment writes, and vault-wide file operations require a trusted workspace.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: The initial secure vault implementation supports local file-system workspaces only.
config.codeTheme: Color theme used for syntax highlighting in fenced code blocks. "auto" follows VS Code's color theme (light/dark), matching VS Code's own Dark+/Light+ palette.
config.codeTheme.auto: Follows VS Code's color theme (light/dark), using VS Code's standard Dark+/Light+ palette.
config.codeTheme.darkPlus: VS Code's standard dark theme (Dark+) palette.
config.codeTheme.lightPlus: VS Code's standard light theme (Light+) palette.
config.enabledStyles: The CSS theme applied to the live preview. Pick one exclusively from "CSS Themes" in the sidebar (global setting).
config.defaultEditor: Controls whether .md files open in Markdown Live Preview by default.
config.defaultEditor.prompt: Keep the normal text editor as the default; open Live Preview manually from the toolbar button.
config.defaultEditor.livePreview: Always open .md files in Markdown Live Preview.
config.defaultEditor.default: Always open .md files in VS Code's normal text editor.
config.remoteMedia: Controls whether Markdown can load images from the network. Remote media can reveal your IP address and viewing activity. HTTPS permission must be set for this workspace or workspace folder; user-global values are ignored.
config.remoteMedia.block: Block all remote and data-URI images. Local workspace images still render.
config.remoteMedia.https: Allow images over HTTPS. Scripts, styles, fonts, HTTP, data URIs, and other remote content remain blocked.
config.vault.updateLinksOnMove: Update Markdown links and wikilinks when notes or folders are moved or renamed.
config.vault.openDefaultOnStartup: When VS Code has no folder open, create and open a default vault at ~/Documents/Markdown Vault. An existing workspace is never replaced.
config.vault.attachmentFolder: Note-relative folder where pasted and dropped attachments are stored. The resolved folder must remain inside the vault.
config.vault.sortOrder: Sort order used by the Document Vault tree.
config.vault.autoReveal: Reveal the active Markdown file in the Document Vault tree.
config.vault.exclude: Bounded file, folder, or glob patterns hidden from the Document Vault and its local metadata index. Patterns match at any depth; prefix with / to anchor at the vault root. Supports *, ?, and **.
config.diagnostics.enabled: Enable a local, bounded diagnostic log. Markdown bodies, URLs, clipboard data, secrets, and absolute paths are redacted. No diagnostic data is uploaded.
config.diagramRendering: Controls local Mermaid and draw.io rendering. Diagram rendering is always disabled in untrusted workspaces.
